title: Bennett--Bernstein, Freedman, and Hoeffding concentration inequalities
abstract: Develops variance-sensitive sub-gamma moment-generating-function estimates, Bennett and Bernstein bounds, a Freedman--Bernstein upper tail for finite adapted sums, conditional and independent-variable Hoeffding inequalities.

informal.Contrib.Bennett.hasSubgammaMGF_of_bounde: A centered real random variable bounded above by a positive constant, with bounded second moment, satisfies a Bennett--Bernstein sub-gamma moment-generating-function estimate.
informal.Contrib.Freedman.subgamma_bernstein_tail: A finite adapted sum of conditionally sub-gamma increments satisfies the corresponding variance-sensitive Freedman--Bernstein upper-tail bound.
informal.Contrib.ConditionalHoeffding.hasCondSubg: A bounded random variable with zero conditional expectation satisfies a conditional Hoeffding sub-Gaussian moment-generating-function estimate.
informal.Contrib.Hoeffding.hoeffding_upper: A sum of finitely many independent random variables valued in the unit interval exceeds its mean by t with probability at most exp(-2 t squared divided by the number of terms).
